learning_outcomes.text: Introduction to definitions, descriptions and parts of operator environment of supervisory control systems and data acquisition and the use of tools in development software for data visualization.

syllabus_topics: Development environment - configuration of objects, object libraries, symbols and smart objects.
The database of monitored variables - data types.
Trends - real and historical - tools, filtration in the historical data.
Communication with external data provider application environment.
Access to process data, the hierarchy of competencies and workstations
bibliography: Boyer S. A.: SCADA. Supervisory Control and Data Acqusition.
Breaking the barriers. Supplement to Automation World. PDF document. August 2007. URL: http://fs1.vsb.cz/8_LANDRYOVA_VIZUAL/
institution: Vysoka Skola Banska- Technicka Univerzita Ostrava
